name: S&P 500
notes: Broad US market benchmark; the default risk-on/off gauge.

name: Nvidia
notes: AI bellwether; can move whole indices (DeepSeek Jan 2025 -17%).

name: Apple
notes: Largest weight; China-supply & tariff sensitive.

name: Gold
notes: Safe-haven & real-rate/inflation hedge.

name: Brent crude oil
notes: Global oil benchmark; geopolitics-sensitive.

name: Bitcoin
notes: Crypto bellwether; liquidity/regulation/risk sensitive.

name: USDC (stablecoin peg)
notes: Peg = systemic-stress gauge (depegged Mar 2023).

name: US Dollar Index
notes: Broad USD; rises on risk-off and hawkish Fed.

name: DAX
notes: Germany's 40 largest listed companies; closes 17:30 Frankfurt.

name: Euro Stoxx 50
notes: The euro area's 50 largest companies; closes 17:30 Frankfurt.

name: German Bund 10Y
notes: Eurozone risk-free benchmark.

name: US Treasury 10Y
notes: US risk-free benchmark; measured as yield in bps — yield rises when price falls.

name: VIX (equity volatility)
notes: The fear gauge; spikes on every risk-off event.

name: Sovereign CDS (EM / periphery)
notes: Default-risk gauge (Russia 2022, Italy, EM).

name: Baltic Dry Index
notes: Dry-bulk freight; China-demand & disruption gauge.

name: EUR/USD
notes: The euro in dollars; 58% of the dollar index, so mostly its mirror. Yahoo's daily close is the price at 00:00 London of the bar's day.

name: Nasdaq Composite
notes: Every Nasdaq-listed stock; the growth end of US equities; closes 16:00 New York.

name: US Treasury 5Y
notes: The front end of the curve; measured as yield in bps like the 10-year.

name: FTSE 100
notes: London's 100 largest listed companies; closes 16:30 London.

name: STOXX Europe 600
notes: 600 companies across Europe; closes 17:30 Zurich.

name: US aerospace & defence ETF
notes: iShares U.S. Aerospace & Defense; the defence outcome of dated shocks.

name: US energy sector ETF
notes: Energy Select Sector SPDR; oil's equity echo.
